model.scope:
Price actual dynamic instruction traces with the repository's hwsim model.

Perfect caches, no memory/bus/SQ/DMA events and no final completion drain.
This is a synthetic CPU scheduling comparison, never hardware time or FPS.

controls: data read of current opcode word retained
double-register move counted as one 8-byte load
store queues excluded from cached footprint
cached PREF counted separately from demand loads

whole_frame_scenario.label: MODELLED admission overhead in a hypothetical 200 MHz frame
whole_frame_scenario.assumptions: Primary and room spill already full. Exactly 43 extra-tail attempts through the uncapped laser-line admission path: 42 accepted 192-byte requests plus the first refusal, 8064 bytes used and 128 left; no payload stores or rendering. Cycles/200000 gives milliseconds at 200 MHz. One continuous trace, one cold-I start for the entire sequence.
whole_frame_scenario.excludes: Actual game lookup cost, primary/spill checks before this adapter, packet building, FIFO/render/PVR, bus stalls and any base frame cost. This is not the total game-frame time or a speedup prediction.

limits: Full unchanged native_ui object, with symbol visibility edited only in a copy for isolated linking. Real newlib memset. Synthetic getter/room-state callbacks and small caller are included in traces and identified separately; real lookup subsystem timing is excluded. Payload arenas unmapped. Not a final game link, console timing or rendering speedup.
